title: Senior Full-stack Engineer (.Net / React)
description:
Our Customer:

Our customer is an international technology company developing a modern cloud-based SaaS platform used by businesses to automate and optimize their daily operations. The product serves enterprise customers and is built with scalability, reliability, and long-term maintainability in mind. The engineering team follows modern development practices, values clean architecture, and actively collaborates across product, design, and QA to deliver high-quality software.


Your Tasks:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack web applications using .NET and React.
  • Build reusable, maintainable, and high-quality backend and frontend components.
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs and integrate backend services.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, UX/UI Designers, QA Engineers, and other developers throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to technical decisions.
  • Optimize application performance, scalability, reliability, and security.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues across both frontend and backend systems.
  • Work with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, deployment configurations, and monitoring tools to support reliable software delivery.
  • Perform code reviews and share technical knowledge within the team.
  • Follow Agile methodologies and software engineering best practices.


Required Experience and Skills:

  • 5+ years of commercial experience in full-stack software development.
  • Strong hands-on experience with .NET / C#.
  • Strong experience with React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs.
  • Solid knowledge of SQL databases.
  • Experience working with Docker, deployment pipelines, and monitoring tools.
  • Experience with Git and modern CI/CD workflows.
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, software architecture, and design patterns.
  • Experience working for a large, globally recognized product or technology company.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively in a cross-functional Agile team.
  • Upper-Intermediate English or higher.


Would Be a Plus:

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Experience with microservices architecture.
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes or container orchestration.
  • Experience with automated testing and TDD.
  • Previous mentoring or technical leadership experience.
